Inspect persisted paw sessions

Usage:
  paw session [command]

Available Commands:
  list        List sessions in the current workspace
  show        Show a persisted session

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for session

Global Flags:
      --config string       config file
      --log-format string   log format: text, json (default "text")
      --log-level string    log level: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
      --no-color            disable colored stderr output
      --trace-file string   trace file
      --verbose             verbose output

Use "paw session [command] --help" for more information about a command.
